detail: No xi value, fit coefficient, threshold, or progenitor datum is passed into Starbreaker.
The evaluator reads the already-executed 3D CSV rows and does not invoke Starbreaker dynamics.
p indexes the internal ledger-packing family; it is not xi_2.5 and receives no physical compactness units.
Starbreaker remnant fraction is an internal fate fraction, not a black-hole probability or mass.
The gate uses strict ordering and predeclared 90% stability thresholds, not an optimized physical cutoff.
Only the frozen O'Connor-Ott compactness direction is scored.
